title: Administration

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: System settings and Docker resource cleanup
settings.scheduleDescription: Automatically run a Docker cleanup every day at the configured time
settings.scheduleEnabledDescription: When enabled, the selected cleanups run daily at the chosen hour
settings.scheduledHourDescription: Hour of day (UTC) when the cleanup runs
settings.cleanupTargetsDescription: Choose which resources the scheduled cleanup removes
settings.domainDescription: Choose how this Nexploy instance is reached: a domain with HTTPS (Let's Encrypt or your own certificate), this server's IP address over plain HTTP, or a domain plus its IP address as a backup way in
settings.domainModeIpDescription: Reach this instance over HTTP through the server IP address, without any certificate
settings.domainModeLetsEncryptDescription: Traefik requests and renews a certificate automatically — the domain must point to this server
settings.domainModeCustomDescription: Serve HTTPS with a certificate you uploaded in SSL certificates
settings.certificateDescription: The certificate must cover this domain (a wildcard certificate works too).
settings.acmeEmailOptionalDescription: Optional — kept so Let's Encrypt stays available for your deployed domains
settings.fallbackIpDescription: Also serve Nexploy over plain HTTP on this server's IP address, so you keep a way in if the domain or its certificate breaks.
settings.domainWarning: Saving restarts Nexploy and the reverse proxy — this takes a few seconds and briefly interrupts access.
settings.domainRestarting: Nexploy is restarting with the new domain settings — this takes a few seconds. Reload the page shortly.
settings.callbacksTitle: Required actions after a domain change
settings.callbacksDescription: URLs to update with your Git providers
settings.callbacksHint: Git providers do not expose an API to change these URLs, so you have to update them yourself. Webhooks are updated automatically when you change the instance domain.
settings.upgradeDescription: Check for updates and upgrade Nexploy to the latest version
settings.upgradeWarning: Upgrading restarts Nexploy and its Docker management API — this takes a few seconds and briefly interrupts access.
settings.upgradeRestarting: Nexploy is upgrading — this takes a few seconds. Reload the page shortly.
settings.upgradeActiveBuildsWarning: The following builds are currently running and will be cancelled if you upgrade now:
settings.retentionDescription: Entries older than the retention period are removed automatically every night.
settings.retentionDaysDescription: Set to 0 to keep every entry forever.
settings.retentionPurgeAllDescription: Empties the whole activity log, ignoring the retention period.
settings.retentionPurgeAllConfirmDescription: The entire activity log will be permanently deleted, including recent entries. This action cannot be undone.
settings.dockerEngineDescription: Version of the Docker daemon this environment is connected to
settings.dockerEngineUnavailable: Unable to reach the Docker daemon
settings.diskGuardDescription: Block builds, deployments and every other space-consuming operation before the server disk fills up
settings.diskGuardEnabledDescription: When enabled, builds, image pulls, container and volume creation are refused once a threshold is reached
settings.diskGuardWarnPercentDescription: Above this usage an alert is recorded in the activity log, without blocking anything
settings.diskGuardBlockPercentDescription: Above this usage every space-consuming operation is refused. Must be higher than the warning threshold
settings.diskGuardMinFreeDescription: Operations are also refused below this amount of free space, whatever the percentage
settings.networkExposureDescription: Control whether published container ports are reachable from outside the server, through its public IP address
settings.networkExposureBindLoopback: Disable access through the server IP
settings.networkExposureBindLoopbackDescription: Published ports are bound to 127.0.0.1 instead of every interface. Containers stay reachable through Traefik and their domains, but not through http://server-ip:port
settings.networkExposureStillExposedTitle: Containers still reachable through the server IP
settings.networkExposureStillExposedDescription: The setting applies to newly created containers. {count} existing container(s) still publish their ports on every interface — recreate them to apply the new binding.
settings.networkExposureRebound: Container recreated with the new port binding

roleDescriptions.guest: Read-only access: repositories, builds, Docker resources and monitoring. No modifications and no access to secrets.
roleDescriptions.developer: Day-to-day deployment work: manage repositories, builds, deployments, environment variables, pipelines, domains, SSL certificates and Docker resources. No integration or user management.
roleDescriptions.admin: Full access: everything a Developer can do, plus management of integrations (Git, registries, DNS, Bucket Storage), Swarm infrastructure, Traefik, cleanup, AI and users.

registry.passwordCreateHint: Leave empty if no authentication is required
registry.passwordEditPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep current password
registry.passwordEditHint: Leave empty to keep the existing password
registry.noRegistries: No registries configured. Add one to push images during builds.
registry.noRegistriesDescription: Add a Docker registry to push your built images
registry.deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete the registry {name}? This action cannot be undone.
registry.mirrorDescription: Pull an image from any registry and push it to a configured registry
registry.mirrorStarted: Mirroring to {target} started. Follow its progress from the running actions menu.
registry.localDescription: Run a private Docker registry on this server and use it for your deployments
registry.localHostDescription: Address other machines use to reach this registry. Leave out the port, it is added automatically.
registry.localDataPathDescription: Absolute path on the host where the registry images are stored
registry.localInsecureWarning: This registry runs without TLS or authentication. Every Docker daemon pushing or pulling from it must list it as an insecure registry.
registry.localImageHint: The registry runs from the {image} image.

buildRunners.tokenWarning: Copy this token now, it will never be shown again.
buildRunners.installHint: Requires Docker on the build machine. The runner connects on its own, no inbound port to open.
